- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.

- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

## Describe the bug

A Qwen3-VL target served with an EAGLE3 draft crashes on the first draft-extend that carries more than a trivial batch. Single requests are served fine, so the server looks healthy until real traffic arrives.

`ForwardBatch._compute_mrope_positions` builds `batch_size` mRoPE positions for a draft-extend whose forward pass has `sum(extend_lens)` = `batch_size * num_draft_tokens` tokens. The rotary embedding then indexes past the end of the position tensor.

Two symptoms, one cause:

- default (fused Triton mRoPE): `CUDA error: an illegal memory access was encountered`, reported asynchronously so the traceback points elsewhere
- with `MRotaryEmbedding.forward_native`: `RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (40) must match the size of tensor b (10) at non-singleton dimension 0` (10 requestsx 4 draft tokens vs 10 positions)

Root cause, in `python/sglang/srt/model_executor/forward_batch_info.py`, `_compute_mrope_positions`, multimodal extend branch:

```python
mrope_positions = mm_input.mrope_positions[
    :,
    extend_prefix_len : extend_prefix_len + extend_seq_len,
]
if mrope_positions.numel() == 0:
    mrope_positions = self._expand_mrope_from_input(
        mm_input, self.seq_lens_cpu[batch_idx]
    )
```

1. `mm_input.mrope_positions` only spans the original prompt.
2. On draft-extend, `prepare_for_extend_to_fill_draft_kvcache` sets `prefix_lens = seq_lens`, which has already moved past the prompt, so the slice above is emptyand the fallback runs.
3. `_expand_mrope_from_input` is decode-shaped and returns `[3, 1]`. The extend needs `extend_seq_len` (= `num_draft_tokens`) positions per request.

`torch.cat` therefore yields `[3, batch_size]` where the forward pass has `batch_size * num_draft_tokens` tokens.


### Reproduction

## Reproduction

### Minimal, CPU only

No GPU, no model weights, no draft checkpoint:

```python
"""CPU-only repro: draft-extend gives a multimodal request too few mRoPE positions."""
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch
from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context

BATCH_SIZE, NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS, PROMPT_LEN, DELTA = 10, 4, 16, 5
override = get_context().override_server_args(model_path="dummy")
override.install()

def mm_input():
    return SimpleNamespace(
        mrope_positions=torch.arange(PROMPT_LEN).unsqueeze(0).repeat(3, 1),
        mrope_position_delta=torch.tensor([[DELTA]]),
        mrope_position_delta_repeated_cache=None,
    )

seq_len = PROMPT_LEN + 20          # decoding has moved past the prompt
fb = ForwardBatch.__new__(ForwardBatch)
fb.forward_mode = ForwardMode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2
fb.seq_lens_cpu = torch.full((BATCH_SIZE,), seq_len, dtype=torch.int64)
batch = SimpleNamespace(
    multimodal_inputs=[mm_input() for _ in range(BATCH_SIZE)],
    extend_lens=[NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS] * BATCH_SIZE,
    prefix_lens=[seq_len] * BATCH_SIZE,
)
fb._compute_mrope_positions(SimpleNamespace(device="cpu"), batch)

got = fb.mrope_positions.shape[1]
want = BATCH_SIZE * NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS
print(f"mrope_positions columns : {got}")
print(f"tokens in the forward   : {want}")
assert got == want, f"{want} query rows vs {got} positions -> rotary embedding reads out of bounds"
print("OK")
```

Output on main @ `4792ab1e9`:

```
mrope_positions columns : 10
tokens in the forward   : 40
AssertionError: 40 query rows vs 10 positions -> rotary embedding reads out of bounds
```

### End to end

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct \
    --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 \
    --speculative-draft-model-path taobao-mnn/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-Eagle3 \
    --speculative-num-steps 3 \
    --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
    --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
    --port 40000
```

Then send ~10 concurrent image requests with a few hundred output tokens each. Single requests pass; the batch dies on the first draft-extend:

```
File "sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_worker_v2.py", line 1011, in forward_batch_generation
    self.draft_worker._draft_extend_for_decode(batch, batch_output)
File "sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_worker_v2.py", line 778, in _draft_extend_for_decode
    draft_logits_output = self.draft_runner.forward(...)
File "sglang/srt/model_executor/model_runner.py", line 3339, in forward_extend
File "sglang/srt/models/llama_eagle3.py", line 228, in forward
File "sglang/srt/layers/rotary_embedding/mrope.py", line 320, in forward_cuda
File "sglang/srt/layers/rotary_embedding/triton_kernels.py", line 131, in triton_mrope_fused
RuntimeError: Triton Error [CUDA]: an illegal memory access was encountered
```

Note on versions: the end-to-end crash above was observed on 0.5.13.post1. The affected code is byte-identical on current main (`4792ab1e9`), and the CPU repro above fails there too.

Related: #14060 reports a nearby failure (Qwen2.5-VL + EAGLE3, `_draft_extend_for_decode`, mRoPE positions) but was closed as inactive and surfaces differently (`'list' object has no attribute 'to'`).

I have a fix plus a CPU regression test and will open a PR.

title: [Bug] Qwen3-VL + EAGLE3: draft-extend emits too few mRoPE positions, crashing on any batched traffic
